description: ErbB family signaling (EGFR/ERBB2/ERBB3/ERBB4) and the canonical RAS/MAPK and PI3K/AKT effector cascades downstream, plus accessory PLC-gamma and JAK/STAT branches.
notes: Bundled for documentation of the gene-set used in the upstream per-spot GSEA. The GSEA NES values in example_slide_gsea_her2_nes.parquet were computed against this gene set; the SPAND pipeline downstream uses only those NES values, so the gene list itself is not consumed by the notebooks.
